# ZSMKit

Copied from the local `CX16/zsmkit/src` checkout, 2026-10-11.
Commit: `0ace36e8ebf14ff6567274586ffe59faa16e8837`.
Upstream: https://github.com/mooinglemur/zsmkit

These unmodified sources are built without `ZSMKIT_ENABLE_STREAMING`.
The MIT license is included in `LICENSE`. Chess uses memory playback on
priority 0 for music and priority 1 for effects, with the default IRQ handler.
